title: Same stock, same rules. Half the futures lose money.
hook: Dark truth: you don't get the average return. You get one path.
beats: {prob_loss} of {n_paths} simulated futures ended below where they started, after only {days} days.
Same stock. Same {sigma} volatility. The worst path fell to {worst}. The best hit {best}.
Every line is one possible future. Same rules, wildly different endings.
The spread between them is the risk you actually signed up for.
takeaway: The average is a story about many people. Your account lives on one line.
caption: One stock, one set of rules, a thousand futures. Your result is just one of them. Simulated data, fixed seed.
